spanish: Y acercamos ofrenda de Jehová, varón que halló utensilio de oro: brazalete y pulsera, anillo, zarcillo y kumaz, para expiar sobre nuestras almas delante de Jehová.

findings.issue: כומז is a common noun (H3558), not a proper name; Spanish dumps the untranslated lemma as kumaz.

notes: Remaining tokens match in number, person, stem, participants, and construct relations.
